indexing: After Astro rendering, before Cloudflare static packaging. Explicit registered candidates; virtual HTML strips source controls, navigation and maintenance entries. Original rendered content remains unchanged.
language: A shared index uses English stemming while retaining Turkish text. No Turkish morphological matching guarantee.
unresolvedBehavior: Intended relative URLs; genuine 404 for absent pages, HTTP 200 for existing pages with missing fragments. No prototype fallback.
